pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit irregular polygonal to sub-rounded geometries with smooth pixel-level edge gradients. Relative spatial area of patches is largest on the mid-flank and decreases toward the neck and limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light tan negative space forms a continuous topological graph with multi-directional junction nodes. Pathway thickness is variable but remains generally uniform relative to the scale of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour along the dorsal neck and shoulder, indicating the presence of a short mane against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced ventral distension visible on the posterior flank, creating a significant convex deviation from the expected linear abdominal silhouette.
